🎥🎬: The Bastard Son & The Devil Himself (2022)

Nathan Byrne is the illegitimate son of Marcus Edge, the world’s most feared blood witch. Growing up, Nathan is treated with suspicion and feared because everyone believes he may inherit his father’s violent legacy.

As his seventeenth birthday approaches, Nathan is caught between rival witch factions and begins uncovering the truth about his mysterious powers and his family. Forced to run for his life alongside other young witches, Nathan must figure out who he can trust while confronting the legacy he never chose.

source_details.synopsis: The Bastard Son & The Devil Himself is a British fantasy drama television series created by Joe Barton, based on the novel Half Bad by Sally Green. The series tells the story of Nathan Byrne, a young man discovering his true identity as the illegitimate son of the dangerous witch Marcus Edge. Netflix released the series on 28 October 2022. It was met with positive reviews, although Netflix cancelled future episodes.
